{{Top|leg}}
'''Datatechs''' were specialized [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], skilled in the retrieval of coded [[Computer/Legends|computer]] information locked behind encrypted computer files. After [[Automata Galactica/Legends|Automata Galactica]] acquired [[Industrial Intelligence/Legends|Industrial Intelligence]] through a less than amicable merger, Industrial Intelligence encrypted much of their top-secret project data. Datatechs, working alongside [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]], worked for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to decrypt the information.
